contexts.text: Pure, beaten () = genuine and clear. Explained.

Thou shalt beat some of it very small () = the arranging of truths in their own series... Beating = has a similar signification to grinding... but is predicated of oil, frankincense, and spices. Explained, Illustrated.
Bruised for our iniquities = His frightful temptations.
Broken () = broken, and not cohering with any interior truth which gives stability.
